Desc.SourceString: 当日破坏场景中物件，必定额外获得随机数量方斯，该效果至多触发30次。
Desc.LocalizedString: When destroying objects today, you'll receive bonus random amounts of Fons. This effect can trigger up to 30 times.

Desc.SourceString: 车辆的强度提升「车辆受到的损坏降低50%」，次日失效。
Desc.LocalizedString: Vehicle durability increased (Vehicle damage reduced by 50%). Expires the following day.

Desc.SourceString: 当日再次抽取扭蛋机，必定会使一个蓝色扭蛋替换为紫色扭蛋。
Desc.LocalizedString: When the Gacha Machine is used again today, it is guaranteed to drop 1 additional Purple Gacha.

Desc.SourceString: 当日再次抽取扭蛋机，必定会使一个蓝色扭蛋替换为金色扭蛋。
Desc.LocalizedString: When the Gacha Machine is used again today, it is guaranteed to drop 1 additional Gold Gacha.

Desc.SourceString: 在获得此祝福后，当日首次购买售货机内任意道具时，可额外再获得1份相同道具。
Desc.LocalizedString: After receiving this blessing, you'll get an additional item when making your first purchase from a Vending Machine today.

Desc.SourceString: 当日击败大世界中的怪物时，有一定概率额外获得「素材道具」，该效果至多触发3次。
Desc.LocalizedString: When defeating monsters in the open world today, you have a chance to receive additional materials. This effect can trigger up to 3 times.

Desc.SourceString: 当日击败大世界中的怪物时，有一定概率额外获得随机数量甲硬币，该效果至多触发10次。
Desc.LocalizedString: When defeating monsters in the open world today, you have a chance to receive additional random amounts of Beetle Coins. This effect can trigger up to 10 times.

Desc.SourceString: 抵御1次致命伤害，并将生命值回复到受伤之前。该祝福仅限当日生效，触发后消失。
Desc.LocalizedString: Prevents 1 fatal hit and heals back to before the damage. This blessing only lasts for the current day and disappears once triggered.

Desc.SourceString: 禁止驾驶车辆
Desc.LocalizedString: Banned from Driving

Desc.LocalizedString: Grants <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> when a target under this status actively attacks your team during the duration.

Desc.SourceString:
「包包蚊从未遇到过像你这样富裕又慷慨的人——它已经在你身上饱餐了整整10顿，方斯填满了肚子，短时间内再也吃不下一点儿。」
15分钟内，「包包蚊」将不会吸取方斯。

"The Pouch Mosquito has never encountered someone as wealthy and generous as you. After feasting on you for a full 10 meals, it's completely stuffed with Fons and can't eat another bite for a while."
For 15 minutes, the Pouch Mosquito will not drain Fons.

Desc.LocalizedString: Increases all allies' DoT dealt by 20%.

Desc.SourceString: 释放极轨终结后，明音凛攻击力提升20%，持续20秒。重复触发刷新持续时间。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases Akane Rin's ATK by 20% for 20s after casting Ultimate. Resets the duration when triggered again.

Desc.SourceString: 释放强化变轨技能「同调共振」后，明音凛暴击伤害提升30%，持续15秒。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases Akane Rin's Crit DMG by 30% for 15s after casting Synced Resonance.

Desc.SourceString: 释放强化变轨技能「同调共振」后，明音凛暴击伤害提升64%，持续25秒。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases Akane Rin's Crit DMG by 64% for 25s after she casts Synced Resonance.

Desc.SourceString: 附着于单个敌人的标记，普通攻击可远距离传导至该目标。
Desc.LocalizedString: Attaches to a single enemy. Relays Basic Attack DMG to the marked target over long range.

Desc.SourceString: 部署在场地中的领域，可将普通攻击传导给范围内敌人。
Desc.LocalizedString: A field deployed on the battlefield that relays Basic Attack DMG to enemies within range.

Desc.SourceString: 进入「华彩连段」状态，持续20秒，期间抗打断能力提升75%。状态持续4秒后，可再次点按极轨终结释放第二段并提前结束「华彩连段」状态。状态结束时仍未释放，第二段将失效，不会自动释放。
Desc.LocalizedString: Enters the Solo Cadenza state for 20s, increasing Resistance to Interruptions by 75%. Press Ultimate again after 4s to cast the second instance, ending Solo Cadenza early. The second instance does not trigger automatically and becomes unavailable if not cast before Solo Cadenza ends.

Desc.SourceString: 全队获得{0}无视防御，持续20秒，重复触发刷新持续时间，该效果队伍内唯一。
Desc.LocalizedString: Grants the whole team {0} DEF Ignore for 20s. Resets the duration when triggered again. This effect is unique within the team.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者额外获得{0}无视防御，持续20秒，重复触发刷新持续时间，该效果队伍内唯一。
Desc.LocalizedString: Grants the wearer an additional {0} DEF Ignore for 20s. Resets the duration when triggered again. This effect is unique within the team.

Desc.SourceString: 全队无视敌人{0}光属性异能抗性，持续20秒，重复触发刷新持续时间，该效果队伍内唯一。
Desc.LocalizedString: Grants the whole team {0} Cosmos Resistance Penetration for 20s. Resets the duration when triggered again. This effect is unique within the team.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者每造成1次暗属性伤害，全场召唤物造成的伤害提高{0}，最多叠加10层，持续20秒，重复获得刷新持续时间。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases DMG dealt by all summons on the field by {0} for 20s whenever the Wearer deals Chaos DMG, up to 10 stacks. Resets the duration when triggered again.

Desc.SourceString:
信号强度从「弱信号」增强至「中等信号」后，获得增益效果「错视幻觉」。
释放「变轨技能：对你说再见」时，可消耗所有「错视幻觉」，并依据消耗层数转化为本次技能的倍率提升。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Grants the Optical Illusion buff when Connection Strength increases from Weak Connection to Medium Connection.
Consumes all Optical Illusions to increase the skill's DMG Ratio based on the number of stacks when casting Goodbye to You.

Desc.SourceString: <TextHLT>「盈蓄」强化</>：当前驻场角色获得终结能量时，全队角色的<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>提升<NumGreen>3.75%</>，持续<NumGreen>30</>秒，最多叠加<NumGreen>8</>层，重复触发刷新持续时间。
Desc.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>Charge Enhancement</>: Increases the whole team's <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> by <NumGreen>3.75%</> for <NumGreen>30</>s whenever the active character gains Ultimate Energy, up to <NumGreen>8</> stacks. Resets the duration when triggered again.
